### [`room_lantern_count_init`](../../../src/lantern_counts.asm#L7) `$4CCE-$4CE1`

*data*

Number of lanterns in each room at a game start (20 bytes), copied by reset_lantern_counts to room_lanterns_left ($2A-$3D). Matches the length of each lantern list.
